title: Fishers and coastal communities announce march against Mumbai desalination plant
seoTitle: Mumbai march against Manori desalination plant

tea.why: Protesters oppose the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's desalination plant, citing threats to marine biodiversity and fishing livelihoods.
tea.want: They demand that authorities scrap the proposed Manori desalination plant project.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Fishing unions announced a shutdown in the Manori-Gorai region and a march to the District Collector's Office in Bandra on October 19.

summary: Fishers, residents, and fishing unions in Mumbai have announced a shutdown in the Manori-Gorai region and a march to the District Collector's Office in Bandra on October 19, 2026. Organised by groups such as the Gorai Villagers Welfare Association, the Akhil Maharashtra Machhimar Kruti Samiti, and the Maharashtra Machhimar Kriti Samiti, the action opposes the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's proposed desalination plant at Manori. Participants argue that the project threatens traditional fishing grounds, marine biodiversity, and livelihoods through seawater intake and hypersaline brine discharge. Unions also questioned the financial viability and environmental impact of the plant, suggesting instead that the city prioritize plugging water leakages. No official response from municipal or government authorities was detailed in the sources regarding the planned march.
demands: Scrap the proposed Manori desalination plant
Protect traditional fishing grounds and marine biodiversity
Prioritize plugging water leakages instead of building desalination plants
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Fishing unions announced a region-wide shutdown and a march to the District Collector's Office in Bandra for October 19.
